# mtncloud_price_set (Data Source)

The Price Set data source allows details of a Price Set to be retrieved by its name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_price_set" "resource_price_set" {
  name = "resourceprice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud price set.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) The code of the MTN Cloud price set
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
